articles.summary: VTP-1000, an antigen-specific immunotherapy to treat celiac disease, showed a dose-dependent pharmacological effect in the SAD portion of the trial VTP-1000 was well-tolerated with no treatment-related SAEs The MAD portion of the trial, which includes a gluten challenge, is ongoing GERMANTOWN, Md.,
articles.title: Barinthus Bio Announces Update on Phase 1 AVALON Clinical Trial of VTP-1000 for the Treatment of Celiac Disease
